summary: This is an 8-K filed by Quantum Leap Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, to report the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) of 20,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit for gross proceeds of $200 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one redeemable warrant. The filing also covers the entry into related underwriting and warrant agreements. This is a standard IPO closing report and does not represent a special situation such as a business combination, tender offer, restructuring, or other event-driven category. The SPAC category is reserved for de-SPAC transactions, not the IPO itself.
